name: Cyprus Department of Civil Aviation
notes: Role split verified: the DCA (mcw.gov.cy/mcw/dca) is responsible for the provision and regulation of air traffic services in the Nicosia FIR and the Larnaca and Paphos towers, so it fills both CAA and ANSP roles on this single entity (source once). Its legacy Domino site shows a 'Civil Aviation Department Emblem' only as a 100x57 GIF (topRight.gif) in the page header, and GIF is not a supported format for this collection, so nothing was stored. No brand page or terms located.
